mission: Establish one Linear A construction whose relation/action and participant roles are independently supported and discriminate rivals.
reading_note: Sound-values are conventional Linear-B-derived labels. The critical structural result does not depend on the restored HT94b final NE.

personnel_basis: HT7 is classified in Palmer's personnel-only group because AB100/VIR occurs on the same tablet.
HT7a begins with QE-TI and the human ideogram AB100/VIR, followed by numbered entries.
Palmer groups HT87 among W+N tablets best paralleled by Linear B personnel lists.
Davis & Valério note KU-RU-KU has a possible Linear B male-name parallel ku-ru-ka.
HT117 consists of 1-lists; Davis & Valério identify multiple entries elsewhere on the tablet with possible Linear B male anthroponym parallels.
DI-KI-SE recurs beneath QI-TU-NE on both HT87 and HT117.

repeated_relation.same_scribe: HT Scribe 9 according to Davis & Valério / inherited corpus
repeated_relation.interpretation: A stable structural classification/affiliation relation is supported; its lexical semantics are not.

pure_action_or_predicate.reason: The same secure expression is directly quantified as 1 on HT7b, which is awkward for a purely verbal/predicate-only account. Nominalized event readings remain logically possible.

commodity_label.reason: HT7 is independently anchored as a personnel tablet; HT87/117 are personnel-like 1-lists. A commodity-only meaning does not naturally fit all secure contexts.

personnel_category_or_status.reason: Can head lists of personnel-like entries and can itself be counted as one personnel-designation item.

person_or_account_designation.reason: A person, office, account holder, or institutional designation can head an account/list and appear as a counted entity elsewhere.

place_or_institution.reason: A place/institution can classify personnel and be independently counted or recorded.

homography_or_distinct_lexemes.reason: Repeated spelling does not by itself prove one lexeme; however identical secure spelling at one site and repeated structural associations make total nonidentity less economical, not impossible.

role_symmetry.reason: No independently calibrated counterparty, expected/recorded pair, or overt operation distinguishes those directions.
role_symmetry.positive_relation: membership/classification is the only relation directly supported by repeated heading-entry structure.

validation.reason: HT7, HT87, HT94 and HT117 are already exposed within the project/literature. No random split is treated as independent validation.
retrospective_sensitivity: Remove HT94 entirely: secure heading/count contrast still holds via HT7 + HT87/117.
Treat HT94 final NE as unresolved: secure result unchanged.
Remove HT7 or downgrade its QI-TU-NE reading: secure cross-position result no longer follows.
Remove one DI-KI-SE occurrence: replicated classification relation drops from two witnesses to one.

mission_result.advance: QI-TU-NE is now securely shown to have cross-position behavior in personnel-related administration and to classify DI-KI-SE in two records.
mission_result.remaining_barrier: No independent evidence identifies the administrative direction or an overt action/predicate.
